description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. Six component layers describe traffic and other signs, furniture, fences and gates, bollards, and amenities along the Foothills Trail. The source identifies bicycle and pedestrian safety, ownership, construction and accessibility attributes. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for capacity planning studies. The layers share one trail asset inventory and are grouped as components. Most descriptions specify 2010; present condition and serviceability are unknown. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
